name: Google Docs (read-write, service account)
description: Google Docs, read and edit (scope documents): documents.create, get (with tabs, suggestions and comments view modes), batchUpdate (text, styles, tables, images, tabs, headers and footers, comments, suggestions, …). No Drive endpoints, so it cannot share, move, export, or delete files. Auth: drawlatch signs a JWT with GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY (base64 of the service-account JSON key file) and mints short-lived access tokens for exactly this scope; the agent never sees the key. Without a subject: it edits documents shared with the service account as Editor and link-shared ones whose link grants edit; Viewer sharing makes them read-only; Commenter sharing doesn't allow content changes but may still let it comment, since batchUpdate includes insertComment and addCommentReply (not tested against Google); and it cannot create documents (service accounts own no files). With a subject (domain-wide delegation): it reaches every document that user can open and can create documents owned by that user. See CONNECTIONS.md "Google (scoped)".

testConnection.description: Reads the ID of the public sample document from Google's Docs API quickstart (needs the Docs API enabled)
